comment: TAKE BOB SPIRES. he is a ray of freaking sunshine and he grades so easy. on all major papers including the final you can get half your points back. I would take this mans class every semster if i could. he is so cute love love love bob

Definitely take this class. Lectures are pretty interesting but he's also super chill and doesn't mind if you are on your computer during class. Reading is "required" but you will be fine if you don't do it. Super understanding, allows for revisions. Some essays, but nothing too bad.

Dr. Spires is amazing. His FYS is very informative with not too much work. A few papers and some reflections are all. Weekly readings are "Required" but if you choose not to read you should be fine as it is covered in class. Many guest speakers meaning classes are entertaining. He allows you to resubmit papers after you fix his corrections.

If you're a freshman looking for an FYS class, this class is incredible. While everyone was complaining about their FYS and all the work they had, I was just chillin in class with Dr. Spires who ALWAYS BRINGS SNACKS?!, guides the lecture for you, lets you know exactly what he's looking for, and gives half credit lost back on essays. Great guy.
Amazing teacher that cares about his students and is so devoted to the topic of human trafficking! The class itself is so stress, and a easy FYS, however you learn a lot.

This was an easy and engaging FYS. Dr. Spires lays out the assignments on Blackboard at the beginning of the semester, and is very tech savvy and accessible. There were 5 reflections, 3 papers, and a vlog. He is an easy grader and gives 50% points back on papers.

Love this class! We have 5 one page journal entires, 1 vlog, and 2 papers and 1 final paper. Dr.Spires is really nice and his work is really easy and his grades very easy. Chill guy and brings tons of guest lectures to talk about Human Trafficking. TAKE THIS CLASS, I promise it is worth it.
Clear rubric and instructions for all assignments, passionate about the material. Wants his students to succeed and makes class interesting (lots of guest speakers, fun presentations).

His Human Trafficking class is super interesting and he has guest speakers come in at least once a week or every two weeks. He assigns readings due every week, but they aren't mandatory cause he goes over the material in class anyways. There are small one page papers due every 2 weeks which are easy A's and he gives 3 easy main papers (5-8 pgs).

By far my favorite professor at UR. He brings a lot of energy to his lectures and he makes them very interactive with plenty of time for discussions. He is super accessible if you need to meet with him and he typically responds to emails very quickly. He shows he cares about his students and that makes a huge difference to me.
